description_en: Generates the parameters and signature required for a file upload URL
description_zh: 生成上传文件链接所需的参数和签名
name: CreateTempFileUploadUrl

parameters.help_en: The name of the file to be uploaded
parameters.name: file_name

BucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket to which the file is uploaded
BucketName.description_zh: 上传文件到OSS使用的Bucket名称

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the call is successful

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint that is used to upload the file to OSS
Endpoint.description_zh: 上传文件到OSS使用的OSS接入点地址

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the signature that is used to upload the file to OSS. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 上传文件到OSS使用的签名的过期时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the call is successful, "successful" is returned. If the call fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

OssAccessKeyId.description_en: The AccessKey ID that is used to upload the file to OSS

Policy.description_en: The policy that is used to upload the file to OSS
Policy.description_zh: 上传文件到OSS使用的策略

Signature.description_en: The signature that is used to upload the file to OSS
Signature.description_zh: 上传文件到OSS使用的签名

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败

TempFileKey.description_en: The key that is used to upload the file to OSS
